script.title: GETTING A TRAIN DELAY REFUND
script.scene_zh: 車站櫃台 · 申請退款
script.story_hook: A commuter wants a refund after a long delay.
script.intro_zh: 通勤者因為列車嚴重誤點，到櫃台申請退款。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, everyone! Today we're asking for a delay refund.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎大家回來！今天我們要申請誤點退款。
script.outro: All done for today! One more listen, then your turn.
script.outro_zh: 今天就全部到這裡！再聽一遍，換你了。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat these useful lines together now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們現在一起跟讀這些實用句子。
script.char_a_description: a pregnant commuter in her thirties with a blunt black bob, wearing an olive utility jacket and a burgundy scarf, balancing a paper coffee cup against her belly
script.char_b_description: a bald station agent in his fifties with a thick gray beard and wire glasses, wearing a maroon service vest over a light-blue shirt, a staff badge on a lanyard
script.youtube_title: 【🚆誤點退款實用英文】「聽起來挺公道的」怎麼說？💸🧾收據・部分退款・儲值金一次搞懂｜聽完就會用｜Train Delay Refund English
script.youtube_title_en: “That Sounds Fair to Me” — Getting a Train Delay Refund
script.youtube_description:
列車誤點幾十分鐘，錢可以要回來嗎？這段車站櫃台的實際對話，教你有理有據地申請退款！從出示收據、比較現金與儲值差別的問法，到領取誤點乘車證，18 句美式日常英語附上繁體中文與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Did your train run late — can you get money back? This real station-counter dialogue shows you how to ask for a refund with confidence. Present a receipt, compare cash versus credit, and collect a delay pass — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA and a listen-and-repeat finish.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚆誤點退款英文｜申請退款・儲值現金比較・誤點乘車證｜聽完就會申訴｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
列車誤點幾十分鐘，還讓你誤了轉車，這筆錢該怎麼辦？
第一次用英文申請退款，不知道從何開口嗎？

這一集帶大家走進車站的售票櫃台，跟著通勤乘客從說明誤點經過、查找電子票據，到選定退款方式、多拿到一張誤點乘車證，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🧾 說明狀況與申請：例如 “My 8:15 ran forty minutes late.”、“I'd like to ask about a refund.”。
💳 比較退款方式：例如 “Which is faster, cash or credit?”、“Credit lands today; cash takes a week.”。
🎫 收下誤點補償：例如 “This delay qualifies for half back.”、“Here's a gate delay pass, too.”。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次列車再晚點，別生氣——拿出收據，微笑把該你的問回來！
script.thumbnail_action: showing a phone ticket to the agent

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, my 8:15 ran forty minutes late yesterday.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ maɪ eɪt fɪfˈtɪn ræn ˈfɔr·ti ˈmɪn·ɪts leɪt ˈjɛstər·deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我昨天那班8點15分晚點了四十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry about that. Did you miss your connection?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑ·ri əˈbaʊt ðæt dɪd ju mɪs jɔr kəˈnɛk·ʃən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, so I'd like to ask about a refund.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs soʊ aɪd laɪk tə ɑsk əˈbaʊt ə ˈri·fʌnd/
dialogue.zh: 是的，所以我想申請退款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. Do you have a ticket receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr θɪŋ du ju hæv ə ˈtɪ·kɪt rɪˈsiːt/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。您有買票的收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I bought it on the app. Is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪ bɔt ɪt ɑn ði æp ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我是在應用程式買的，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fine — we can search by your email.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn wi kæn sɜrtʃ baɪ jɔr ˈi·meɪl/
dialogue.zh: 可以的，我們能用電子郵件查到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, it's jordan dot reyes at mail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ɪts ˈdʒɔr·dən dɑt ˈreɪ·eɪz æt meɪl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. This delay qualifies for half back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ðɪs dɪˈleɪ ˈkwɑ·ləˌfaɪz fɔr hæf bæk/
dialogue.zh: 查到了。這次誤點符合退一半的資格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half back? Well, that sounds fair to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf bæk wɛl ðæt saʊndz fɛr tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 退一半？嗯，聽起來挺公道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can do a full refund as travel credit.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn du ə fʊl ˈri·fʌnd æz ˈtræ·vəl ˈkrɛ·dɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我也可以把全額退成旅行儲值金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which is faster, cash or credit?
dialogue.zh: 哪個比較快，現金還是儲值？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Credit lands today; cash takes a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrɛ·dɪt lændz təˈdeɪ kæʃ teɪks ə wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 儲值今天入帳；現金要一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Credit's perfect — I ride the line weekly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrɛ·dɪts ˈpɜr·fɪkt aɪ raɪd ðə laɪn ˈwiːk·li/
dialogue.zh: 儲值剛好——我每週都搭這班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call. Here's a gate delay pass, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl hɪrz ə ɡeɪt dɪˈleɪ pæs tu/
dialogue.zh: 好選擇。這還附一張閘門誤點乘車證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, what's this one good for?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs wʌts ðɪs wʌn ɡʊd fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 噢真好，這張可以做什麼用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It covers a free ride on delayed lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈkʌ·vərz ə fri raɪd ɑn dɪˈleɪd laɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 遇到誤點的線路，可以免費搭乘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That really helps a lot. Thanks so much!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈrɪ·li hɛlpz ə lɑt θæŋks soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 這真的幫了大忙，太謝謝了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glad we fixed it. Safe travels home!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæd wi fɪkst ɪt seɪk ˈtræ·vəlz hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 很高興幫您處理好。回家的路上小心！
